issues_in: Source spot-check hard-fail (review-brief item 4): lightweight GET returned 403 for https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/20mw-off-grid-data-center-planned-outside-salt-lake-c
fixed: Replaced the bot-blocked Data Center Dynamics article URL in sources.refresh_2026_08_11 with the article's Wayback Machine snapshot (web.archive.org/web/20260130151256/https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/20mw-off-grid-data-center-planned-outside-salt-lake-city-utah/, verified HTTP 200, contains full DCD 2026-01-30 article) and added Fox13Now open-house coverage (https://www.fox13now.com/news/local-news/utah-county/summit-ridge-data-center-sparks-debate-in-santaquin-over-power-water-and-pollution, verified HTTP 200).
Replaced the DCD URL in contradictions[0].sources (capacity_mw) with the Wayback Machine snapshot of the same DCD article (which states '20MW+ project ... Data Center Power Company').

Replaced the DCD URL in contradictions[1].sources (status) with the Wayback Machine snapshot plus Fox13Now (which reports 'there's still no groundbreaking date as of yet'), keeping the no-construction-start claim source-backed.
Annotated both contradiction descriptions with the Wayback access method for the DCD article and Fox13Now corroboration for the status claim.
Appended a history entry (2026-08-11) to data.json documenting the URL swap.
Appended a dated bullet to the NOTES.md 2026-08-11 section documenting the swap with both replacement URLs (kept historical refresh bullets intact).
remaining_risks: The live DCD article URL still returns 403 to automated clients (bot-protection, article itself exists); the Wayback Machine snapshot is now the cited access path and its availability depends on archive.org.
DataCenterMap returned HTTP 429 (rate-limited) on spot-check, not a dead link; kept as-is since the review did not flag it.
Historical NOTES.md refresh bullets (lines 10-14) still cite the original DCD URL as the record of what was used on 2026-08-11; left intact as history, with the new bullet documenting the swap.
ABC4 article (same open house) was also bot-blocked (403) and therefore not added as a replacement.
summary: Fixed the single review issue (403 on the Data Center Dynamics source URL) by swapping in the article's verified Wayback Machine snapshot in sources and both contradictions, plus a working Fox13Now local-news source for the no-construction-start claim. Added a data.json history entry and a NOTES.md dated note documenting the swap; data.json validates as JSON and no bare dead URL remains.
